title: Receipt
description: Durable proof of what actually happened when an action ran: against which exact source version, by whom, on what device and build, with what result, and whether its text target was exact, refound, approximate, or lost. A notification is not a receipt; this record is.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

sourceId.description: Id of the Source the action ran against.

sourceRevision.description: The exact version of the source the action ran against.

actionId.description: Id of the Action that ran.

executor.description: Who or what carried out the action.

host.description: The app or service the action ran inside.

device.description: The device the action ran on.

build.description: The exact app build that carried out the action.

result.description: What actually happened, in plain words.

artifactDigest.description: Digest of the produced artifact, as 'sha256:<hex>', where the action produced one.

authority.description: Whose permission this action ran under.

arrival.description: How the stored text target resolved in the current source: exact, uniquely refound, block-level approximate, or lost.

degradationNote.description: When arrival was not exact, exactly what moved, changed, or was reduced, named plainly.

undoRoute.description: How the person can undo what this receipt records, if undo is possible.

repairRoute.description: How the person can fix things if this result was wrong.

recoveryRoute.description: How the prior state can be recovered if something was lost.

returnRoute.description: The exact way back to the position in the source where the action started.
